title: 创建并运行第一个ament_python节点

steps.command: cd ~/ros2_ws/src && ros2 pkg create my_first_pkg --build-type ament_python --dependencies rclpy

steps.code:
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node

class HelloNode(Node):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__('hello_node')
        self.get_logger().info('Hello ROS2!')

def main(args=None):
    rclpy.init(args=args)
    node = HelloNode()
    rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.1)
    node.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

expected_output: ros2 run可找到my_first_node并打印Hello ROS2!
failure_cases: No executable found：检查setup.py console_scripts并重新build/source
ModuleNotFoundError：检查源码文件位置和包名
rollback: 删除~/ros2_ws/src/my_first_pkg并重新构建即可移除示例包
verification_method: 逐步核对命令退出状态、ROS图/日志与预期输出；失败时按failure_cases定位。
